copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一个统一入口来操控和检查任务
copy.tagline_en: Send start, stop, or status commands, or freely describe a task
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a single hub to run and inspect tasks

howto.what: Claude 会管理一个本地消息中枢:可启动、停止或查看状态,让 Codex、Gemini、Claude 等代理互相收发消息、转交任务;非 start/stop/status 的输入按中枢相关自由任务处理。
howto.when: 用户话里带上 tfx-hub 并给出 start、stop、status 等命令词时,立即执行;其余输入当作中枢/桥接/消息总线域自由任务处理。

say.note: 查看中枢、代理和队列状态。
非命令词,按自由任务转发处理。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a local message hub: it can start, stop, or report status, let CLI agents such as Codex, Gemini, and Claude exchange messages and hand off tasks; inputs that don't match start/stop/status are treated as hub-related freeform tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user invokes tfx-hub with start, stop, or status; any other argument is handled as a freeform task in the hub/bridge/message-bus domain.

say_en.note: Launches the local MCP hub server.
Gets status from the local HTTP endpoint.

say_en.text: Help me analyze the message bus.
say_en.note: No command keyword matches, so it is routed as a freeform task.
